long_biography.plain_text:
After practising as a real-estate lawyer, Rick Caruso entered property through airport lots leased to his father's Dollar Rent A Car. The leases supported bank borrowing; gains from later lot sales supplied capital for retail development. He owned the new venture himself, but the family-company leases supplied a material launch platform.

Rather than copying enclosed malls, Caruso designed outdoor town-centre destinations around shopping, dining and public spaces. Instead of selling completed projects to repay outside equity investors, he retained them, using rental income and refinancing to accumulate value. That approach made him both the creator and continuing owner of the business's core assets. As executive chairman, he now sets founder-level direction while chief executive Corinne Verdery heads the operating team.
